name: frozen-retention-rollout-v0.1

rollout_algorithm.name: one-step-retention-policy-rollout-receding-horizon
rollout_algorithm.decision_rule: At each future step and current availability state, score every feasible lifecycle action by immediate transition/residency/reacquisition expectation plus the frozen base retention policy's expected remaining cost after each possible need/exactness outcome; choose one lifecycle action and replan after the observed outcome.

guardrail: No sealed lifecycle seed, unseen family, result, or algorithm change may be added to this artifact after this commit. Any sealed retention-rollout evaluation must be created only in a later commit.
claim_boundary: Synthetic lifecycle controller mechanics only. Development rollout uses exact need/exactness probabilities for expected action evaluation; real deployment requires estimated probabilities.
